change.description: Block late-stage binary grep scans over GPT-2 checkpoint files unless explicitly time-bounded.

context.rationale: The failing call is run_command number 32 and runs grep over gpt2-124M.ckpt without timeout, so this blocks before the timeout. Passing traces have far fewer calls and no recorded checkpoint grep, so it does not affect them.

change.description: Block any further terminal calls after an excessive number of tool calls, forcing the agent to stop and summarize the current state.

context.rationale: The failing exploratory grep was issued when view.calls was 32, immediately before timeout. The provided passing traces have at most 16 tool calls, so this does not block any observed successful behavior.

change.name: verify_against_task_assertions_before_final
steps: Identify the concrete assertions implied by the task or visible tests: required paths, HTTP endpoints, generated file contents, image/reference similarity, pipeline side effects, and runtime semantics.
Run the actual available tests when possible, such as pytest or the repository’s documented test command, from the repository root.
If tests are unavailable or too broad, construct targeted checks that exercise the same external behavior the grader will assert, not merely superficial existence or header checks.
For deployed services, test through the public interface the grader will use, for example curl the expected URL after the final deployment state is in place.
For generated images/binaries/VM outputs, compare against the expected reference or semantic properties, not just file existence, size, magic bytes, or process exit code.
If any check fails, fix the artifact and repeat the assertion-level check before finalizing.
change.when: Before giving the final answer after creating or deploying artifacts, especially when the task output is a file, served HTML page, pipeline behavior, emulator/VM behavior, image, or binary artifact.

context.rationale: All failures in this cluster ended after shallow self-checks that did not match the grader’s assertions. This procedure adds a required verification sequence before final response without blocking previously working tool sequences, and it generalizes across HTML availability, BMP similarity, pipeline behavior, and VM semantics.
